641:t_014:38.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「If those who hold power beyond human understanding are to be called gods, then in the eyes of present-day humanity, higher-dimensional life forms would qualify.」

641:t_014:39.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But $$テンプティ$$ and the others aren't gods, you know. We're not such grand beings.」

641:t_014:40.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Some conceited fool who's convinced they're a god is just cliched and ridiculous, you know?」

641:t_014:41.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are the $$御使い$$s... servants of God. There is no God but the Supreme God.」

641:t_014:43.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So you haven't changed, after all. Not since that time, 120 million years ago...!」

641:t_014:44.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So these guys are... the rulers of the $$サイデリアル$$...」

641:t_014:45.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$テンシ$$ that $$サイアム・ビスト$$ saw at $$ラプラス$$ was them!」

641:t_014:46.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$御使い$$... They are the true identity of those who watch over humanity's evolution...」

641:t_014:47.en:
$$葵$$
「Does that mean these guys are the ones who destroyed $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s planet too!?」

641:t_014:48.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「We let the $$ジェミナイド$$ live because they're useful as combat strength, you know.」

641:t_014:49.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「But you refused to submit to the $$サイデリアル$$. Begging for forgiveness now is too late.」

641:t_014:50.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Earthlings are dangerous, after all. We were going to erase you whatever your answer, though.」

641:t_014:51.en:
$$ランド$$
「So these guys are the ones who destroyed the Earth $$バルビエル$$ came from!」

641:t_014:52.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That's right. We kept that kid around because he had his uses, you know.」

641:t_014:53.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$ティティ$$! With power like that, why were you with $c!?」

641:t_014:54.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Isn't it obvious? Because it looked like fun.」

641:t_014:56.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「This $$テンプティ$$ governs the emotion of 'Pleasure'.」

641:t_014:57.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Earthlings who keep defying the $$サイデリアル$$... And on top of that, one of you holds the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$. We can't just leave you alone.」

641:t_014:58.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You know about the $$スフィア$$s, too.」

641:t_014:59.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Naturally. They belong to us.」

641:t_014:60.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「In other words, all $$スフィア・リアクター$$s are our possessions.」

641:t_014:62.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You know, right, $$アウストラリス$$~? How grave a crime it is to run off with them?」

641:t_014:64.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「And breaking the restrictions $$テンプティ$$ and the others imposed by cheating, and gathering four $$スフィア$$s... That's unforgivable, you know.」

641:t_014:67.en:
$n
「That story about your father and brother dying and your mother shunning you... Was that...」

641:t_014:68.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Of course it was a lie. I tried making up a setup that you'd find easy to get interested in, $n. How was it?」

641:t_014:71.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What kind of person are you...!」

641:t_014:72.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Quiet, you. I'm talking to $n.」

641:t_014:73.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Was being accepted by people like this... what happiness meant to $$バルビエル$$...?」

641:t_014:74.en:
$$セツコ$$
「His Earth was destroyed, he hated everything... and even so, he tried to cling to these people's power...」

641:t_014:75.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「It is not limited to $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$. Every $$スフィア・リアクター$$ is fated to serve us.」

641:t_014:76.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「So, $n. Come over to $$テンプティ$$'s side.」

641:t_014:77.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Now that $$エルーナルーナ$$ has gone and died on us, I'll make you my number one favorite.」

641:t_014:83.en:
$n
「So there was no $$ティティ$$ with a sad past who lost her life in battle...」

641:t_014:84.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Aren't you frustrated? Aren't you angry?」

641:t_014:86.en:
$n
「Besides... if I did, I'd only be amusing you.」

641:t_014:88.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That positive attitude of yours... I can't resist it!」

641:t_014:89.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「I shall grant you praise for the resolve to overcome all of that, $$アムブリエル・ジ・オーバーライザー$$.」

641:t_014:91.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$ハマリエル・ザ・スター$$...」

641:t_014:93.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$ウェルキエル・ザ・ヒート$$...」

641:t_014:95.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$ズリエル・ジ・アンブレイカブル$$...」

641:t_014:97.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Come to us, along with those $$スフィア$$s.」

641:t_014:98.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That makes eight $$スフィア$$s gathered. All that's left is the four that one is holding.」

641:t_015:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#keyword$$
「It is not permitted to hurt them.」

641:t_015:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#keyword$$
「No... $n... You are not able to hurt them.」

641:t_016:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Is this your doing!?」

641:t_016:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#keyword$$
「The weak who touch this power have their souls stolen and their hearts torn apart.」

641:t_016:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's been a long time, Advent. I heard you were here, so $$テンプティ$$ came to this world too.」

641:t_016:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Twelve thousand years, is it...? You did well to answer our call.」

641:t_016:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#keyword$$
「The great collapse that comes once every 120 million years is near... I merely judged that I can no longer afford to be bound by the past.」

641:t_016:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Just what are you...!」

641:t_016:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#keyword$$
「I am $$喜びのアドヴェント$$. I am the last one of the $$御使い$$s.」

641:t_016:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It connects now! The meaning of why $$ガドライト#pilot$$ burned with rage at you in the $$時獄戦役$$!」

641:t_016:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#keyword$$
「I suppose he realized it. That I was one of the $$御使い$$s who destroyed his home planet, $$ジェミナイ$$.」

アムブリエル・ジ・オーバーライザー.evidence: Doctrine addresses Hibiki (t_014:89) by his Sphere Reactor title; pattern of Hamaliel the Star / Barbiel the Needle; glossary has アムブリエル + ジ・オーバーライザー (The Overriser)

ウェルキエル・ザ・ヒート.evidence: Doctrine addresses Rand (ザ・ヒート) at t_014:93; zodiac angel Leo = Verchiel, same source as Barbiel/Hamaliel/Muriel/Ambriel in glossary

ズリエル・ジ・アンブレイカブル.evidence: Doctrine addresses Crowe at t_014:95; zodiac angel Libra = Zuriel; 'Unbreakable' from the Japanese

kept_omissions: 641:t_014:98: あいつ (holder of the remaining four Spheres) not identified by the scene; kept as 'that one'.
641:t_014:42: Hades' 貴様達は...! kept as bare 'You...!' (verb elided in Japanese too).
641:t_014:79: Hibiki's いいんです kept without object ('It's all right.').
uncertain: 641:t_015:0/2: 彼等 in 'hurt them' taken as the Sidereal (Doctrine/Tempty), and Advent's 君では傷つける事は出来ない as 'you cannot hurt them'; it could also be 'you cannot hurt me'.

641:t_014:89: アムブリエル・ジ・オーバーライザー is addressed to Hibiki (followed by 91/93/95 to Setsuko/Rand/Crowe); glossary lists アムブリエル as female (Suzune's persona), so the full-name token is proposed as a new name.
New names proposed: Verchiel the Heat, Zuriel the Unbreakable (zodiac-angel spellings, matching Barbiel/Hamaliel/Muriel in the glossary).
御使い rendered as the keyword token ($$御使い$$s / 'the $$御使い$$s') = 'Angel(s)' per glossary; first use in the Tengoku output, other slices may differ.
地球種 = 'Earthlings' (matches earlier Sidereal usage); 641:t_014:57 'one of you holds the Quarreling Twins Sphere' is addressed to the Earth party.
641:t_014:73: 幸せだったの... rendered as a question; could be a statement.
641:t_014:48/52: ジェミナイド and Barbiel referred to without certain plural; Barbiel as 'he' per glossary (male).
